topography.project_purpose: Set Protocol enables creation and management of tokenized index baskets (Sets) that automatically rebalance based on predefined strategies, allowing users to gain diversified exposure to multiple crypto assets through a single ERC-20 token.
topography.relationship_narrative: The Vault contract manages the issuance and rebalancing of Sets, while CErc20 and its proxy CErc20Delegator represent Compound lending market integrations that likely serve as yield-bearing components or collateral within the Set baskets.
